body_markdown:
NEW YORK


, Nov. 24, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Centuri Holdings Inc. (NYSE: CTRI) will replace DoubleVerify Holdings Inc. (NYSE: DV) in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Tuesday, December 1. Nielsen Holdings is acquiring DoubleVerify Holdings in a deal expected to close soon, pending final closing conditions.


Following is a summary of the changes that will take place prior to the open of trading on the effective date:
